dog.description_text:
My foster writes: Meet Koa! 🐾✨
Under a year old, this sweet, outgoing girl is the total package-part active playmate, part professional snuggle bug! Koa is a smart, affectionate pup who is completely off her shelter meds, handles being left loose at home for up to 6 hours like a absolute champ, and loves to snooze on the couch when it's downtime.

Fun Facts & Highlights:
The Happy Dance: Koa does the cutest little excited dance whenever you bring her a snack!
Lap Dog Dreams: She loves her humans so much she'll try to crawl right into your lap for snuggles, no matter how big she gets.
Smart & Easygoing: Great on leash walks, knows "sit," and already learned her kitchen blanket spot!
Social Butterfly: Friendly with strangers, great with kids, and loves running and wrestling with other high-energy dog pals.
Koa is looking for an active home ready for some fun play sessions, interactive toys, and endless affection. If you're looking for a loving companion who will greet you with pure joy and cuddle up with you at night, Koa is your girl! 🐶❤️

My foster writes: Koa is looking for a home where she can snuggle with her family and as a puppy, play with her toys and people. She also loves to nap and self soothes easily when left home alone. She's a catch!

What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

It is unknown if I have ever lived with other animals or children.

I would do best in a home without very tiny humans, although I could be open to older human children once I meet them.

I am excitable and energetic! I will need positive outlets for my energy!
dog.name: Koa
